blocks.text: about yoki of? — predlog ma'noni o'zgartiradi

Bu darsdagi fe'llar **about** bilan ham, **of** bilan ham keladi va ko'pincha ma'no o'zgaradi: hear **about** / hear **of** / hear **from**, think **about** / think **of**, dream **about** / dream **of**, remind **about** / remind **of**, complain **about** / complain **of**. think about / of qizil kitobda qisqacha o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 113-dars). Umumiy tamoyil: **about** — mavzu, batafsil ma'lumot, uzoq fikrlash; **of** — mavjudlik, bir lahzada kelgan g'oya, o'xshashlik. O'zbekchada esa hammasi bitta fe'l: «eshitmoq», «o'ylamoq», «eslatmoq» — shuning uchun farqni predlog orqali his qilish kerak.
hear about, hear of, hear from

**hear about** — voqea yoki yangilik **haqida** eshitmoq, ma'lumot olmoq: Did you hear **about** the fire? **hear of** — kim yoki nimaningdir **borligini** bilmoq, nomini eshitgan bo'lmoq (ko'pincha never / ever bilan): I've never heard **of** this writer. **hear from** — kimdandir **xabar olmoq** (xat, qo'ng'iroq, xabar orqali): Have you heard **from** Aziz since he moved? Rasmiy xat oxirida: I look forward to hearing **from** you.

rows: Have you **heard about** the new metro line?

items.text: Have you **heard about** the accident on the motorway this morning?
items.translation: Bugun ertalab avtomagistralda bo'lgan avariya **haqida eshitdingizmi**?

items.text: I'd never **heard of** Khiva until I saw a documentary about it.
items.translation: Xiva haqida hujjatli film ko'rmagunimcha, uning **nomini** ham **eshitmagan** edim.

items.text: We haven't **heard from** our son since he left for Canada.
items.translation: O'g'limiz Kanadaga ketganidan beri undan **xabar olmadik**.

blocks.text: **think about** — biror narsa ustida **o'ylamoq**, mulohaza qilmoq, ko'rib chiqmoq: I'm thinking **about** your offer. **think of** — 1) fikr **kelmoq**, o'ylab topmoq: Can you think **of** a name for the café? 2) **fikr, baho**: What do you think **of** my essay? (bu ma'noda about ham mumkin); 3) **eslamoq**: I can't think **of** his name. Reja haqida ikkalasi ham: I'm thinking **of / about** changing jobs. Qiyoslang: I **thought about** it — o'ylab ko'rdim (vaqt sarfladim); I **thought of** it — xayolimga keldi (bir lahzada).

items.text: I need a few days to **think about** the offer before I decide.
items.translation: Qaror qilishdan oldin taklif **haqida o'ylab ko'rishim** uchun bir necha kun kerak.

items.text: Who **thought of** the idea of a charity concert? It's brilliant!
items.translation: Xayriya konserti g'oyasi**ni** kim **o'ylab topdi**? Ajoyib-ku!

items.text: What did you **think of** the hotel we stayed in?

blocks.text: dream about, dream of; wouldn't dream of

Tushda ko'rmoq — **dream about**: Last night I dreamt **about** my school. Orzu qilmoq — **dream of** yoki **about**: She dreams **of** opening her own restaurant. **I wouldn't dream of** + -ing — «xayolimga ham keltirmayman», hech qachon qilmayman: I wouldn't dream **of** reading your diary. British English da o'tgan zamon shakli **dreamt** ham, **dreamed** ham to'g'ri.

**remind** somebody **about** something — biror narsani **unutmasin deb** eslatmoq: Can you remind me **about** the meeting? Fe'l bilan: remind somebody **to** do something (→ 55-dars). **remind** somebody **of** somebody / something — **o'xshatmoq**, yodiga solmoq: You remind me **of** my sister. This song reminds me **of** our holiday. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «eslatmoq», lekin inglizcha ma'nosi butunlay boshqa: birinchisi — vazifa yoki sana, ikkinchisi — o'xshashlik yoki xotira.

items.text: Please **remind** me **about** the dentist on Friday — I always forget.
items.translation: Iltimos, juma kungi tish shifokorini men**ga eslatib qo'ying** — doim unutaman.

items.text: This narrow street **reminds** me **of** the old town in Bukhara.
items.translation: Bu tor ko'cha men**ga** Buxorodagi eski shahar**ni eslatadi**.

blocks.text: complain about / of; warn about / of

**complain (to somebody) about** something — norozilik bildirmoq: complain **to** the manager **about** the service. **complain of** — og'riq yoki kasallik belgisi haqida aytmoq: He complained **of** a headache. **warn** somebody **about** / **of** — xavf haqida ogohlantirmoq: The guide warned us **about** pickpockets (of — rasmiyroq, yangiliklarda ko'p: warn **of** floods). Qilmaslikni maslahat berish: warn somebody **not to** do yoki **against** doing.

items.text: Several guests **complained to** the manager **about** the noise from the bar.
items.translation: Bir nechta mehmon bardan keladigan shovqin **haqida** menejer**ga shikoyat qildi**.

items.text: Grandpa **complained of** chest pains, so we took him straight to hospital.
items.translation: Bobom ko'kragi og'riyotgani**dan shikoyat qildi**, shuning uchun uni darhol kasalxonaga olib bordik.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I'm waiting to hear of you» → **hear from** you; «Did you hear of the accident?» (voqea haqida) → **hear about**; «You remind me about my brother» (o'xshatish) → **remind me of**; «Remind me of the meeting» (unutmaslik uchun) → **remind me about** the meeting; «complain on the food» → **complain about**; «dream with you» → **dream about** you; «I thought about a good idea» (xayolga keldi) → **thought of**.

**about** = «haqida» — batafsil, uzoq: hear about the news, think about the offer, complain about the food. **of** = qisqa, bir lahzalik yoki «borlik»: hear of somebody (borligini bilaman), think of a name (xayolga keldi), remind me of (o'xshatdi). **from** — manba: hear from Kate (Keytdan xabar keldi).
Bog'lanish: talk / ask / care about — 133-dars; accuse of, consist of — 135-dars; remind somebody to do — 55-dars; predlogdan keyin -ing (thinking of moving, dream of opening) — 60-dars.

examples.title: **hear about** or **hear of**?
examples.description: hear about — voqea, yangilik haqida eshitmoq; hear of — kim yoki nimaningdir borligini bilmoq, nomini eshitgan bo'lmoq (ko'pincha never / ever bilan).

sentences.text: Did you **hear about** the fire at the old cinema last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun eski kinoteatrda bo'lgan yong'in **haqida eshitdingizmi**?

sentences.text: I've never **heard of** this restaurant — is it new?
sentences.translation: Bu restoran**ning nomini** hech **eshitmaganman** — yangimi?

sentences.text: Everyone in the office has **heard about** Tom's promotion.
sentences.translation: Ofisdagi hamma Tomning lavozimi ko'tarilgani **haqida eshitgan**.

sentences.text: Have you ever **heard of** a city called Termez?
sentences.translation: Termiz degan shahar**ni** hech **eshitganmisiz**?

sentences.text: We first **heard about** the job from a friend who works there.
sentences.translation: Bu ish **haqida** birinchi marta o'sha yerda ishlaydigan do'stimizdan **eshitdik**.

sentences.text: Not many people outside Uzbekistan have **heard of** the poet Alisher Navoi.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistondan tashqarida ko'p odamlar shoir Alisher Navoiy**ning nomini eshitmagan**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I hadn't **heard about** your accident — are you all right now?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, baxtsiz hodisangiz **haqida eshitmagan** ekanman — hozir yaxshimisiz?

sentences.text: A musician that nobody had **heard of** won the competition.
sentences.translation: Hech kim **nomini eshitmagan** bir musiqachi tanlovda g'olib bo'ldi.

sentences.text: When did you **hear about** the changes to the exam? — Only yesterday!
sentences.translation: Imtihondagi o'zgarishlar **haqida** qachon **eshitdingiz**? — Faqat kecha!

sentences.text: Is that a real company? I've never **heard of** it, and I work in the industry.
sentences.translation: Bu haqiqiy kompaniyami? Men shu sohada ishlayman, lekin uning **nomini** hech **eshitmaganman**.

examples.title: **hear from**: getting news from people
examples.description: hear from somebody — kimdandir xabar olmoq (xat, qo'ng'iroq, xabar). Rasmiy xatlarda: I look forward to hearing from you.

sentences.text: Have you **heard from** Madina since she moved to Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: Madina Edinburgga ko'chganidan beri undan **xabar oldingizmi**?

sentences.text: We look forward to **hearing from** you in the near future.
sentences.translation: Yaqin orada siz**dan xabar kutib qolamiz**.

sentences.text: I haven't **heard from** the bank yet, so I don't know if they'll give me the loan.
sentences.translation: Bank**dan** hali **xabar yo'q**, shuning uchun kredit berishadimi-yo'qmi, bilmayman.

sentences.text: If you don't **hear from** me by six, call the hotel.
sentences.translation: Agar soat oltigacha men**dan xabar bo'lmasa**, mehmonxonaga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: It's lovely to **hear from** you after all these years!
sentences.translation: Shuncha yillardan keyin siz**dan xabar olish** juda yoqimli!

sentences.text: Bekzod **heard from** the university that his application had been accepted.
sentences.translation: Bekzod arizasi qabul qilingani haqida universitet**dan xabar oldi**.

sentences.text: How often do you **hear from** your relatives in Manchester?
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi qarindoshlaringiz**dan** qanchalik tez-tez **xabar olib turasiz**?

sentences.text: Nobody has **heard from** the climbers since Tuesday, and people are getting worried.
sentences.translation: Seshanbadan beri alpinistlar**dan** hech kim **xabar olmadi**, odamlar xavotirlana boshladi.

sentences.text: Kate was delighted to **hear from** an old friend she'd lost touch with.
sentences.translation: Keyt aloqasi uzilib qolgan eski dugonasi**dan xabar olib** juda xursand bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Once we **hear from** the landlord, we'll know when we can move in.
sentences.translation: Uy egasi**dan xabar kelgach**, qachon ko'chib o'tishimiz mumkinligini bilamiz.

examples.title: **think about**: considering a question
examples.description: think about — biror narsa ustida o'ylamoq, mulohaza qilmoq, ko'rib chiqmoq; ko'pincha qaror qabul qilishdan oldin.

sentences.text: I'll **think about** your offer and give you an answer on Monday.
sentences.translation: Taklifingiz **haqida o'ylab ko'raman** va dushanba kuni javob beraman.

sentences.text: What are you **thinking about**? You haven't said a word for ages.
sentences.translation: Nima **haqida o'ylayapsiz**? Ancha vaqtdan beri lom-mim demadingiz.

sentences.text: Nilufar is **thinking about** studying abroad next year.
sentences.translation: Nilufar kelasi yil chet elda o'qish**ni o'ylab yuribdi**.

sentences.text: Before you buy a car, **think about** the cost of insurance and petrol.
sentences.translation: Mashina sotib olishdan oldin sug'urta va benzin narxi **haqida o'ylab ko'ring**.

sentences.text: I can't stop **thinking about** that strange phone call last night.
sentences.translation: Kechagi g'alati qo'ng'iroq **haqida o'ylashdan** to'xtay olmayapman.

sentences.text: Have you **thought about** what you'll do after graduation?
sentences.translation: O'qishni bitirgandan keyin nima qilishingiz **haqida o'ylab ko'rdingizmi**?

sentences.text: Jasur spent the whole weekend **thinking about** whether to accept the job in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Jasur Farg'onadagi ishni qabul qilish-qilmaslik **haqida o'ylab** butun dam olish kunlarini o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: Don't **think about** the exam now — just try to relax.
sentences.translation: Hozir imtihon **haqida o'ylamang** — shunchaki dam olishga harakat qiling.

sentences.text: The more I **think about** it, the more I like the idea.
sentences.translation: Bu **haqida** qancha ko'p **o'ylasam**, g'oya menga shuncha ko'proq yoqyapti.

sentences.text: Sarah never **thinks about** other people's feelings when she makes jokes.
sentences.translation: Sara hazil qilganda hech qachon boshqalarning his-tuyg'ulari **haqida o'ylamaydi**.

examples.title: **think of**: ideas, opinions and memories
examples.description: think of — 1) g'oya kelmoq, o'ylab topmoq; 2) fikr, baho (What do you think of ...?); 3) eslamoq (can't think of his name); 4) reja: thinking of doing.

sentences.text: Can you **think of** a good name for our new café?
sentences.translation: Yangi kafemiz uchun yaxshi nom **o'ylab topa olasizmi**?

sentences.text: What do you **think of** the new shopping centre? — It's too big for me.
sentences.translation: Yangi savdo markazi **haqida** qanday **fikrdasiz**? — Men uchun juda katta.

sentences.text: I know his face, but I can't **think of** his name.
sentences.translation: Yuzini taniyman, lekin ismi**ni eslay olmayapman**.

sentences.text: Who first **thought of** using the empty factory as an art gallery?
sentences.translation: Bo'sh zavodni san'at galereyasi sifatida ishlatish**ni** birinchi bo'lib kim **o'ylab topdi**?

sentences.text: Now that the children have left home, Dilnoza and Aziz are **thinking of** selling the house.
sentences.translation: Bolalar uydan ketgach, Dilnoza va Aziz uyni sotish**ni o'ylab yurishibdi**.

sentences.text: I've just **thought of** a way to save money on the trip!
sentences.translation: Sayohatda pul tejash yo'li**ni** hozirgina **o'ylab topdim**!

sentences.text: What did Oliver **think of** your presentation? Was he impressed?
sentences.translation: Oliver taqdimotingiz**ni** qanday **baholadi**? Unga yoqdimi?

sentences.text: Whenever I smell fresh bread, I **think of** my grandmother's kitchen.
sentences.translation: Har safar yangi non hidini sezsam, buvimning oshxonasi**ni eslayman**.

sentences.text: Nobody could **think of** an answer, so the room went silent.
sentences.translation: Hech kim**ning xayoliga** javob **kelmadi**, shuning uchun xona jimjit bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: Think about it carefully, and tell me if you **think of** any problems.
sentences.translation: Yaxshilab o'ylab ko'ring va biror muammo **xayolingizga kelsa**, menga ayting.

examples.title: **dream about**, **dream of**; **wouldn't dream of**
examples.description: dream about — tush ko'rmoq; dream of / about — orzu qilmoq; I wouldn't dream of + -ing — xayolimga ham keltirmayman.

sentences.text: Last night I **dreamt about** my old school in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Kecha **tushimda** Samarqanddagi eski maktabimni **ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: Ever since she was a child, Dilnoza has **dreamt of** becoming a pilot.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bolaligidan uchuvchi bo'lish**ni orzu qiladi**.

sentences.text: Do you often **dream about** work? — Unfortunately, yes!
sentences.translation: Ishingiz tez-tez **tushingizga kiradimi**? — Afsuski, ha!

sentences.text: Many young footballers **dream of** playing in the Premier League.
sentences.translation: Ko'p yosh futbolchilar Premer-ligada o'ynash**ni orzu qiladi**.

sentences.text: I **wouldn't dream of** borrowing money from my boss.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'imdan qarz so'rash**ni xayolimga ham keltirmayman**.

sentences.text: Oliver **dreamed about** a huge wave and woke up feeling scared.
sentences.translation: Oliver **tushida** ulkan to'lqin **ko'rdi** va qo'rqib uyg'ondi.

sentences.text: What do you **dream of** doing when you retire? — Travelling around Asia.
sentences.translation: Nafaqaga chiqqach nima qilish**ni orzu qilasiz**? — Osiyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni.

sentences.text: Jasur **wouldn't dream of** missing his mother's birthday, however busy he is.
sentences.translation: Jasur qanchalik band bo'lmasin, onasining tug'ilgan kunini o'tkazib yuborish**ni xayoliga ham keltirmaydi**.

sentences.text: As a student, Sarah **dreamt of** living in a big flat in central London.
sentences.translation: Talabalik paytida Sara Londonning markazida katta kvartirada yashash**ni orzu qilardi**.

sentences.text: Lots of small business owners **dream of** expanding abroad, but few have the money.
sentences.translation: Ko'p kichik biznes egalari chet elga chiqish**ni orzu qiladi**, lekin buning uchun puli borlari kam.

examples.title: **remind** sb **about** or **remind** sb **of**?
examples.description: remind somebody about — unutmasin deb eslatmoq (yoki remind somebody to do); remind somebody of — o'xshatmoq, yodiga solmoq.

sentences.text: Can you **remind** me **about** Madina's birthday next week?
sentences.translation: Kelasi haftadagi Madinaning tug'ilgan kuni**ni** men**ga eslatib qo'ya olasizmi**?

sentences.text: This photo **reminds** me **of** our holiday in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Bu surat men**ga** Xivadagi ta'tilimiz**ni eslatadi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **reminds** me **of** a famous actor, but I can't remember which one.
sentences.translation: Bekzod men**ga** bir mashhur aktyor**ni eslatadi**, lekin qaysi biri ekanini eslolmayapman.

sentences.text: The receptionist **reminded** us **about** checkout time.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimi biz**ga** mehmonxonadan chiqish vaqti**ni eslatdi**.

sentences.text: Does this song **remind** you **of** anything? — Yes, our first dance!
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiq siz**ga** biror narsa**ni eslatadimi**? — Ha, birinchi raqsimizni!

sentences.text: Please **remind** the students **to** bring their passports on Friday.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, talabalar**ga** juma kuni pasportlarini olib kelishni **eslatib qo'ying**.

sentences.text: The smell of rain always **reminds** Kate **of** her childhood in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir hidi Keyt**ga** doim Oksforddagi bolaligi**ni eslatadi**.

sentences.text: Thanks for **reminding** me **about** the meeting — I'd completely forgotten.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish**ni eslatganingiz** uchun rahmat — butunlay unutib qo'ygan ekanman.

sentences.text: Who does the new manager **remind** you **of**? She looks very familiar.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer siz**ga** kim**ni eslatadi**? Juda tanish ko'rinyapti.

sentences.text: My phone **reminds** me **about** every appointment, but I still manage to be late.
sentences.translation: Telefonim men**ga** har bir uchrashuv**ni eslatib turadi**, lekin baribir kechikishga ulguraman.

examples.title: **complain about** / **of**; **warn about** / **of**
examples.description: complain (to sb) about — norozilik bildirmoq; complain of — og'riq, kasallik belgisi; warn somebody about / of — xavf haqida ogohlantirmoq.

sentences.text: Several passengers **complained about** the dirty seats on the train.
sentences.translation: Bir necha yo'lovchi poyezddagi iflos o'rindiqlar**dan shikoyat qildi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother has been **complaining of** back pain for weeks.
sentences.translation: Buvim haftalardan beri bel og'rig'i**dan shikoyat qilyapti**.

sentences.text: Did anyone **warn** you **about** the traffic on the ring road?
sentences.translation: Kimdir sizni halqa yo'lidagi tirbandlik **haqida ogohlantirdimi**?

sentences.text: If the food is cold, **complain to** the manager, not the waiter.
sentences.translation: Ovqat sovuq bo'lsa, ofitsiantga emas, menejer**ga shikoyat qiling**.

sentences.text: The doctor **warned** Aziz **about** the side effects of the medicine.
sentences.translation: Shifokor Azizni dorining nojo'ya ta'sirlari **haqida ogohlantirdi**.

sentences.text: After the chemical leak, residents **complained of** sore eyes and headaches.
sentences.translation: Kimyoviy moddalar oqib chiqqandan keyin aholi ko'z achishishi va bosh og'rig'i**dan shikoyat qildi**.

sentences.text: Neighbours **complained to** the council **about** the rubbish in the street.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilar ko'chadagi axlat **haqida** shahar kengashi**ga shikoyat qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Scientists have **warned of** a serious water shortage in the region.
sentences.translation: Olimlar mintaqada jiddiy suv tanqisligi **xavfi haqida ogohlantirishdi**.

sentences.text: What are you **complaining about** now? The weather is perfect!
sentences.translation: Endi nima**dan shikoyat qilyapsiz**? Havo ajoyib-ku!

sentences.text: I did **warn** you **about** that hotel, but you didn't listen.
sentences.translation: Sizni o'sha mehmonxona **haqida ogohlantirgan** edim-ku, lekin quloq solmadingiz.

examples.title: Dialogue: news from an old friend
examples.description: Suhbat: hear from, hear about, hear of, remind of, complain about, think of, dream of, remind about, think about — bitta vaziyatda.

sentences.text: — Guess who I **heard from** yesterday? Oliver, from our course in Oxford!
sentences.translation: — Kecha kim**dan xabar olganimni** top-chi? Oksforddagi kursimizdan Oliver!

sentences.text: — Really? I haven't **heard** anything **about** him for years. How is he?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Yillardan beri u **haqida** hech narsa **eshitmadim**. Ahvoli qanday?

sentences.text: — Great! He's working for a company called Greenline. Have you **heard of** it?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Greenline degan kompaniyada ishlayapti. Uning **nomini eshitganmisiz**?

sentences.text: — No, never. But it's funny — you've just **reminded** me **of** our trip to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, hech qachon. Lekin qiziq — hozir men**ga** Edinburgga qilgan sayohatimiz**ni eslatdingiz**.

sentences.text: — Oh yes! Oliver **complained about** the rain every single day.
sentences.translation: — Ha, albatta! Oliver har kuni yomg'ir**dan shikoyat qilardi**.

sentences.text: — And now he's **thinking of** moving to Tashkent. Can you believe it?
sentences.translation: — Endi esa Toshkentga ko'chib kelish**ni o'ylab yuribdi**. Ishonasizmi?

sentences.text: — Why? What does he **think of** Uzbekistan? He's only been here once.
sentences.translation: — Nega? O'zbekiston **haqida** qanday **fikrda** ekan? U bu yerga faqat bir marta kelgan-ku.

sentences.text: — He says he's always **dreamt of** living somewhere sunny.
sentences.translation: — Uning aytishicha, u doim quyoshli joyda yashash**ni orzu qilgan**.

sentences.text: — Well, **remind** me **about** it when he comes — I'd love to see him.
sentences.translation: — Unda, u kelganda men**ga eslatib qo'ying** — uni ko'rishni juda xohlayman.

sentences.text: — Of course. I'll **think about** a nice place where we can all have dinner.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Hammamiz kechki ovqat qiladigan yaxshi joy **haqida o'ylab ko'raman**.
